name: workflow-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the whole idea-to-shipped pipeline in one install — the core-suite baseline (candor, code-review, git-workflow, hindsight, secret-scanning, skill-router, stack-scan) plus taskmaster clarification and cards, task-runner execution with delegation contracts, approaches deliberation, code-architecture plan-before-code and verification, testing, debugging, and the ui-ux and security lanes the cards dispatch into. Replaces taskmaster-suite, process-suite and quality-principles-suite (2026-09-14). Fifteen members: over the host's 200k skill-listing floor by design — the README names the settings line. Uninstall cleanly with /workflow-suite:uninstall.
